# Prospect shortlist, Brunswick food

Web search is not switched on in this office, so this is from your own notes rather than from outside.

Three worth a call. All independent, all with a shopfront.

1. The pasta place on Albion Street. Two years old, queue out the door on Fridays.
2. The cheese shop near the station. New owners since January.
3. A bakery in Coburg, on the street Acme is opening on. Mention that, or do not call them at all.
